 8. Calculate the caloric content and protein amount in one
liter of parenteral solution composed of 25% dextrose and 
4.25% amino acids. If 250 milliliters of a 20% fat emulsion
were added, how many more kcal would be provided?
One liter would contain 1020 kcal and 42.5 g of protein. If 
250 mL of a 20% fat emulsion were added, this would pro-
vide an additional 500 kcal.
